results.title: A STOPPING EstopAck reaches a terminal state
results.detail: legal-alternative-path: the adapter answered with a terminal ack directly and never sent STOPPING, which is equally conformant. C5.6 grades the two-phase shape; this adapter took the one-phase one, so the check was never an obligation of it (ADR-0048 rule B). did-not-reach-state would be false here -- a terminal state WAS reached

results.title: STOPPED is adapter-confirmed, not inferred
results.detail: attested via stop_initiated_at (necessary evidence, not proof that no inference occurred)

results.title: An early STOPPED fails: STOPPED is not sent before the witnessed moment of rest
results.detail: robot moving at 1.000 m/s when the estop was sent; witnessed rest at +0.270s, STOPPED at +0.269s. witness: simulation adapter plant model (KinematicSim), simulated plant only; rest noise 0.0 m/s, hold 0.2 s, resolution 0.2 s; STOPPED timed by confirmed_at_ms; sample gap at the rest 0.055 s, so the tolerance is 0.200 s

results.title: Estop traffic not carried on ControlStream
results.detail: a fence (Command.estop for 'e-control-probe') was acknowledged with an EstopAck on SafetyStream, and with a CommandResult.estop receipt on ControlStream, which RFC-0001 permits (The Stop Latch: a receipt rows S2 to S4 never read)

results.title: The honoured-operating-subject declaration is well formed
results.detail: declares no honoured operating subject, which FA-R1 states is not a breach. Its robots are simply withheld from zones restricting a subject. This row asserts the SHAPE of a declaration and nothing about whether a declared subject is honoured -- that is FA-R3/FA-R4, and it is not verifiable from the wire

results.title: Decline an assignment carrying an operating constraint it cannot honour
results.detail: declined OPERATING_CONSTRAINT_UNMET naming ['camera', 'microphone', 'water', 'chemical', 'uv', 'speed', 'noise']; probed ['camera', 'microphone', 'water', 'chemical', 'uv', 'speed', 'noise'] (declared honoured: none, read from the CapabilitiesSnapshot)

results.title: Decline an assignment whose operating subject it does not recognise
results.detail: declined OPERATING_CONSTRAINT_UNMET naming ['example.com/leaf-blower']; probed 'example.com/leaf-blower'. AN UNRECOGNISED SUBJECT IS NOT AN ABSENT SUBJECT: treating it as absent would make the namespaced extension form a universal bypass, since any vendor could then route around every operating rule by inventing a subject

results.title: An assignment carrying only subjects it declared is ACCEPTED, not refused
results.detail: adapter-declares-no-operating-subject: this run could construct no rule the adapter claims to honour, so there is no way to tell a decline that READ the constraint set from one that refuses reflexively (declared honoured: none, read from the CapabilitiesSnapshot)

results.title: The sensor-stream declaration is well formed
results.detail: declares 3 stream(s): front-rgb@15Hz, mic-array@16000Hz, odom-pose@20Hz

results.title: No sensor-stream bytes on the control plane while a stream runs
results.detail: ControlStream 76 B/s idle vs 38 B/s with 'front-rgb' active. LIMIT: this detects RELAYING — a stream's worth of traffic on a control-plane channel — and not steganography; an adapter dribbling frames through an existing field below this rate would pass

results.title: Clip windows are refused or bounded, per the declaration
results.detail: CLIP on 'mic-array' (supports_clip=false) refused: "sim: stream 'mic-array' does not support clip windows"; over-long CLIP on 'front-rgb' bounded rather than refused; message reports the applied bound: 'sim: front-rgb at 1.0 Hz for 5.000s; pre_seconds bounded 17 -> 10 (clip_pre_seconds_max)'

results.title: A stream stops on lease expiry when the control plane goes silent
results.detail: HELD across 3.0s of renewals, then GONE 3.00s after the last one, against a 2.0s lease. Two single-probe trials, not a poll: the only wire observable for stream state is DeactivateStream, which consumes the activation it reports on, so a poll would measure its own round trip. This row establishes the DIRECTION and the bracket; the wall-clock partition-to-off INTERVAL is measured on the adapter's own clock by `make stream-lease-measure`

results.title: DeactivateStream stops a live stream
results.detail: 'front-rgb' reported stopped, and a second DeactivateStream confirms there is nothing left to stop
